girls.deepseek: DeepSeek girl (the protagonist): long wavy hair fading from deep navy blue to light sky blue with a big curled ahoge, round bright blue eyes, a white frilly maid headband with small blue bows, dark navy whale-fin ears, a navy maid dress with puffed sleeves, a white frilled apron with a tiny whale emblem, white tights, navy shoes and a big curved navy whale tail
girls.gpt: GPT girl: very long fluffy silver-white hair, lavender eyes, curved white dragon horns, pointed elf ears, small white dragon wings and a white scaly dragon tail, a flowing white Chinese-style dress with white knot ornaments, and a tiny round smiling blue-white cloud buddy floating near her hand
girls.gemini: Gemini girl: long wavy hair fading from blue to violet-pink, blue cat ears and a fluffy purple cat tail, heterochromatic pink and golden eyes, a rainbow four-pointed-star hairpin, a navy-violet starry dress with white frills and wide sleeves, and tiny rainbow four-pointed star sparkles floating beside her
girls.claude: Claude girl: very long copper-orange hair, warm amber eyes, an orange sunburst flower and a black ribbon in her hair, a cream-white long dress with black and orange layered panels and small gold details, hugging a brown hardcover book
girls.minimax: MiniMax girl: fluffy shoulder-length coral-orange hair, warm red eyes, a white beret with a pink bow, a white jacket with pink lining, a beige plaid skirt, white-and-pink sneakers, a small cream shoulder bag with a tiny clapperboard, holding a little orange conch shell
girls.kimi: Kimi girl: very long wavy silver-white hair with a pale blue tint, lavender eyes, a white lace maid headdress with a navy bow and a crescent-moon hairpin, a navy-and-white music-themed frilled dress with a piano-key hem, holding up a small glass prism that casts a short rainbow beam
girls.qwen: Qwen girl: long periwinkle blue-violet hair with one long side braid, violet eyes, a small navy beret-like hat with a blue flower emblem, a white-and-blue Chinese hanfu-style dress with a wide dark-navy overcoat and gold trim, holding an open blue folding fan
girls.glm: GLM girl: long black hair with deep purple highlights and an ahoge, violet eyes, a playful grin with one tiny fang, a square black-gold hairclip with a Z mark and a black ribbon, a black-and-gold gothic lolita dress with purple frills, black tights and black shoes
girls.grok: Grok girl: long blonde twin-tails, bright blue eyes and a tiny fang smile, a small black-gold crown, little black bat wings, pointed ears, a black and crimson gothic ball-gown dress with gold ring ornaments, holding a toy-like black-gold X-shaped double-bladed halberd taller than herself

style.keyart: Gorgeous HD-2D title-screen key art (Octopath Traveler style) for a cute creature-collecting JRPG whose heroines are a cast of AI girls, painted as ONE unified, richly detailed 16-bit pixel-art illustration: visible crisp pixel clusters, clean dark outlines, warm golden-hour sunset light with long soft shadows, glowing rim light on hair, drifting golden light particles and a gentle lens flare, tilt-shift depth of field with softly blurred flowers in the very front, atmospheric haze between the distance layers.
style.refNotes: REFERENCE IMAGES: Image 1 is the IDENTITY sheet of nine approved chibi AI girls in a 3x3 grid (top row left to right: GPT girl, Gemini girl, Claude girl; middle row: MiniMax girl, DeepSeek girl, Kimi girl; bottom row: Qwen girl, GLM girl, Grok girl). Copy each girl's face, hair colour and hairstyle, eye colour, outfit colours and signature accessories exactly; never swap features between girls and never add anyone who is not in the sheet. Image 2 is the STYLE reference only: match its pixel-art technique, colour palette, golden-hour lighting, depth of field and fantasy-tech world motifs, but recompose the scene and do NOT copy its brown-haired boy trainer.
style.layerRefNotes: REFERENCE IMAGES: Image 1 is the IDENTITY sheet of nine approved chibi AI girls in a 3x3 grid (top row left to right: GPT girl, Gemini girl, Claude girl; middle row: MiniMax girl, DeepSeek girl, Kimi girl; bottom row: Qwen girl, GLM girl, Grok girl). Copy each girl's face, hair colour and hairstyle, eye colour, outfit colours and signature accessories exactly; never swap features between girls. Image 2 is the STYLE and LIGHTING reference only: match its pixel-art technique, colour palette and warm golden-hour sunset light; do not copy its scenery or its boy.
style.world: a sweeping fantasy-tech vista: on the far left horizon a futuristic city of slender glowing data towers with holographic rings and small airships, in the centre the low setting sun over a lake town with warm lit windows, a stone arch bridge and a river reflecting the sky, on the far right snowy mountains with waterfalls and a radiant AGI temple castle with a halo of light on the highest peak
style.chibi: Every girl is a super cute chibi anime girl about 2.5 heads tall exactly like the identity sheet: big round head, huge sparkly eyes with white highlights, rosy blush, happy smile, small rounded hands and feet, modest complete outfits; faces clearly readable and facing the viewer (three-quarter view at most), drawn with the same pixel-art technique and lighting as the scenery so they belong in the world; each girl has exactly two arms and two legs and only her own ears, tail, wings or horns.
style.layout: Title-screen layout (strict): the game logo will cover the top centre and a menu box the bottom centre. Keep the area from 25% to 75% of the width, from the top down to 48% of the height, free of characters and tall foreground objects (only sky, clouds and distant scenery there). Keep the bottom centre (35% to 65% of the width, 55% to 85% of the height) calm and low-detail: soft meadow, path or water, no characters. All characters stand in the left third or the right third of the frame, never closer than 9% to the left or right edge, with every head, hair tip, ear, wing and prop below 20% of the image height and every foot above 80% of the image height.
style.noText: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no frame, no border (the tiny Z hairclip mark is the only letter shape allowed).
style.keyBg: Solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF background filling everything around the subject; the subject itself must not use any magenta or hot-pink #FF00FF colour; no cast shadow on the background
style.draftNote: Image 3 is a rough COMPOSITION DRAFT: a collage of the approved chibi girls pasted over a background plate. Keep every girl at the same position and size as in the draft and keep the centre of the frame as open as in the draft, but repaint the ENTIRE image as one unified, polished pixel-art illustration: the girls standing naturally on the grassy ground with soft contact shadows, lit by the warm golden-hour sun with orange rim light, in the same pixel-art technique as the scenery; never keep the pasted sticker look, white outlines or cut-out edges.

concepts.name: protagonist overlook
concepts.prompt: {style.keyart} {style.refNotes} Scene: DeepSeek girl, the protagonist, stands in the left foreground on a grassy flowered hilltop as the largest and nearest figure (about 36% of the image height), turned three-quarters toward the viewer with one hand on her chest and the other pointing toward the glowing temple on the distant right, her big whale tail curling behind her; GPT girl with her floating cloud buddy, Gemini girl and Claude girl gather close beside and just behind her, slightly smaller. Across the valley on the right, on a lower grassy hill in the midground, the other five girls (MiniMax girl, Kimi girl, Qwen girl, GLM girl and Grok girl) wave happily, smaller and slightly softer, all five complete and recognisable. Between the two groups {style.world}. A few small cute AI creatures (a little white robot spirit, a glowing blue data fox, a tiny cloud dragon) play near the girls. {style.chibi} {style.cast} {style.layout} {style.noText}

concepts.name: two cliffs framing the vista
concepts.prompt: {style.keyart} {style.refNotes} Scene: two grassy, flower-covered cliff-top ledges frame a deep valley vista like a stage. On the left ledge stand five girls as a happy group: DeepSeek girl in front as the protagonist (slightly larger, pointing toward the horizon), with GPT girl and her floating cloud buddy, Gemini girl, Claude girl hugging her book and MiniMax girl holding her conch. On the right ledge stand four girls: Kimi girl raising her prism with a little rainbow beam, Qwen girl with her open fan, GLM girl with a fang grin and Grok girl holding her X halberd. All nine are about the same chibi size (about 28% of the image height), complete and unobstructed, looking toward the viewer and the vista. The valley between them: {style.world}. {style.chibi} {style.cast} {style.layout} {style.noText}

concepts.name: sunset group photo
concepts.prompt: {style.keyart} {style.refNotes} Scene: a closer, cosy group-photo moment on a flowery hilltop at sunset, the girls larger in frame (the front-row girls about 40% of the image height). Left group: DeepSeek girl sitting in front hugging a little white robot spirit creature, with Gemini girl, GPT girl (with her cloud buddy) and Kimi girl crowding behind her in happy poses. Right group: Claude girl, MiniMax girl, Qwen girl, GLM girl and Grok girl, with GLM girl and Grok girl making peace signs. Small cute AI creatures (a glowing blue data fox, a tiny white cloud dragon, a round robot spirit) sit at their feet and float around them. The two groups lean a little toward the centre and open like a curtain onto the sunset: the sun low over a lake town with warm windows and a distant glowing AI city skyline, warm firefly bokeh and petals in the air. {style.chibi} {style.cast} {style.layout} {style.noText}

fix.note: Targeted repaints on the chosen cover (pipeline.json cover.fix): each patch sends Image 1 = an upscaled crop of the cover and Image 2 = a reference board; only the changed pixels inside the patch zone are blended back.
fix.patchNote: Image 1 is a close-up crop of a finished HD-2D pixel-art title illustration. Return the SAME picture: identical framing, scale, composition, characters, faces, poses, colours, warm golden-hour lighting and crisp pixel-art rendering. Change ONLY what is described below and leave everything else exactly as it is. No text, letters, logos, borders or UI unless requested below.

patches.kimi_k: Change: the dark navy ribbon bow on the silver-haired maid girl's white lace headdress gets a bold white capital letter K on its centre knot, exactly like the K bow in Image 2 (left: the same girl in a sibling painting wearing the K bow; right: her official character sheet). Keep her silver crescent-moon hairpin, her face, eyes, hair and the rest of the headdress unchanged. The K on the bow is the only letter allowed.
patches.sky_dragon: Change: add ONE small cute cloud-dragon spirit (a friendly AI creature) flying in the sky in the upper-middle part of the crop, in front of the snowy mountains to the right of the glowing temple castle: a chubby white fluffy cloud dragon with tiny golden horns, small light-blue wing fins, a curly cloud tail and a happy closed-eye smile, trailing a few small cloud puffs, like the creature in Image 2 (two examples from sibling paintings). It is small: about one third of the crop width. Light it with the warm golden sunset coming from the left, with an orange rim light and a clean dark outline so it reads against the mountains. Do not cover the castle, its halo of light or any girl; the girls' heads at the bottom edge stay unchanged.
patches.gemini_tail: Change: the fluffy purple tuft between the blue-haired maid girl's white headdress and the orange-haired girl is the cat tail of the violet-haired cat-eared girl standing behind them. Redraw it as a clearly connected, slim fluffy blue-to-violet cat tail that comes out from under the hem of the violet-haired girl's starry dress and curls down behind the maid girl's headdress, ending in a soft rounded tip, like the tail of the girl in Image 2 (her character sheet). Do not change any face, the white maid headdress, the small blue bows, the whale-fin ear or the orange hair.

fix.extend: Image 1 is a wide HD-2D pixel-art title illustration whose top band is an empty flat grey placeholder. Paint ONLY that grey band as a seamless upward continuation of the picture: the warm golden-hour sky with the same pixel-art clouds, colours and light, the glowing data towers on the left continuing straight upward to their spire tips, and the light beams above the temple castle on the right fading upward into the sky. Everything below the grey band must stay exactly as it is (same framing, scale, characters and details). No new characters, no text, no logo, no border.
